# RCW Innovation Inc.

> RCW Innovation is a technology and engineering consulting firm based in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. We build custom software, CRM/ERP systems, AI automation agents, and professional websites for businesses in Calgary and across Canada. We serve bilingual markets in English and Spanish.

## Company

- Legal name: RCW Innovation Inc.
- CEO and Founder: Ricardo Luna Becerra, PhD in Computer Engineering, MBA
- Phone: +1 (587) 896-1997
- Email: info@rcwinnovation.com
- Website: https://rcwinnovation.com
- Languages: English (CA), Spanish (ES-CA)
- Service area: Calgary AB, Alberta, Canada — and remote services across Canada and Colombia

## Services

### Web Design and Development — Calgary
We design and develop professional websites for small and medium businesses in Calgary and Alberta. Services include custom React/Next.js web apps, landing pages, e-commerce, and bilingual (English/Spanish) website design.

### Custom CRM and ERP Software
We build tailored CRM and ERP systems that adapt to each business's specific processes. Our solutions replace generic off-the-shelf tools with software that fits your operations.

### AI Automation and AI Agents
We design and deploy AI automation workflows and AI agents for businesses in Calgary. Services include chatbots, automated lead generation, document processing, voice calling agents, and integration with tools like n8n, Make, and LangChain.

### Digital Transformation Consulting
Strategic consulting for companies adopting new technology. We identify operational bottlenecks, design digital roadmaps, and guide implementation across construction, professional services, healthcare, restaurants, and retail.

### Marketing and SEO
Digital marketing including Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, content strategy, and social media management for Calgary businesses.

## FAQ

Q: What technology services does RCW Innovation offer in Calgary?
A: Web design and development, custom CRM and ERP software, AI automation agents, digital transformation consulting, and digital marketing for businesses in Calgary and Alberta.

Q: Does RCW Innovation build websites in Spanish and English?
A: Yes. We specialize in bilingual web development for businesses serving English-speaking and Spanish-speaking markets in Canada.

Q: Can RCW Innovation build AI agents for my business in Calgary?
A: Yes. We build custom AI agents including chatbots, voice calling agents, lead qualification bots, and document processing automations.

Q: How much does a website cost in Calgary with RCW Innovation?
A: Simple landing pages start around CAD $1,500. Full business websites range from CAD $3,000 to $8,000. Custom web applications are quoted per project.

Q: Where is RCW Innovation located?
A: RCW Innovation Inc. is incorporated and based in Calgary, Alberta, Canada.
